analysis.insight_summary: Users moving from an older to a newer [product_name] version have difficulty adapting to changes in how values are referenced in mathematical operations. The reference button that was previously available is now missing, leading to uncertainty about variable selection during programming. Users desire a consistent and straightforward workflow for choosing variables.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and familiar way to select and use actual values in mathematical computations, just as with the reference button in the earlier [product_name] version.
